1. Coordinator of Student Activities .08 The coordinator shall be a liaison officer between the principal and the coaches and directors of student activities. The coordinator will be responsible for scheduling extra-curricular contests for 9th grade and for scheduling gym-nasiums and activity rooms within the junior high school building.
